automateRepetitiveWork.name: Automate repetitive work
automateRepetitiveWork.blurb: The copy-paste, the re-typing, the chasing — the work your team does over and over that a computer should be doing instead.

talkCustomersScale.name: Talk to customers at scale
talkCustomersScale.blurb: Answer more people, faster, without adding headcount — and keep a person in the loop for the conversations that need one.

connectSystems.name: Connect your systems
connectSystems.blurb: Stop moving data by hand between the tools you already pay for, and make sure everyone is working from the same, current picture.

customProducts.name: Custom products
customProducts.blurb: When nothing off-the-shelf fits, I design and build the product itself — and the software I build for you is yours under the project agreement.

emailAutomation.title: Email automation
emailAutomation.body: Sort, route, and reply to routine email automatically, so messages get answered quickly and nothing slips through the cracks.

documentProcessing.title: Document processing
documentProcessing.body: Pull the data out of invoices, contracts, and forms without anyone re-typing it — fewer errors and hours back every week.

workflowAutomation.title: Workflow automation
workflowAutomation.body: Connect the steps of a process end to end so work moves on its own, instead of waiting on manual handoffs between people and tools.

internalCompanyTools.title: Internal company tools
internalCompanyTools.body: Replace the spreadsheets and manual rituals your team leans on with an app built around exactly how you actually work.

aiAssistants.title: AI assistants
aiAssistants.body: A helper that answers questions and takes action against your own data and systems, so customers and staff get answers without waiting on someone.

aiChatbots.title: AI chatbots
aiChatbots.body: A conversational front door for your site or product that qualifies leads, guides visitors, and hands off to a person only when it needs to.

customerSupportSystems.title: Customer-support systems
customerSupportSystems.body: Triage, draft, and resolve routine tickets automatically, so your team spends its time on the conversations that genuinely need a human.

crmIntegrations.title: CRM integrations
crmIntegrations.body: Keep customer records accurate and in sync across every tool you use, so your team stops working from stale or conflicting data.

apiIntegrations.title: API integrations
apiIntegrations.body: Make the software you already rely on talk to each other cleanly, so data flows automatically instead of being moved by hand.

aiPoweredDashboards.title: AI-powered dashboards
aiPoweredDashboards.body: Live views of the numbers that matter, with plain-language summaries — so you can see what's happening and act without digging through reports.

customSaasProducts.title: Custom SaaS products
customSaasProducts.body: A full product built from first idea to launch when existing software can't do what you need — and you want to own the result rather than rent it.

bespokeAiSolutions.title: Bespoke AI solutions
bespokeAiSolutions.body: Have a problem that doesn't fit a category? I scope and build around it, using AI only where it genuinely earns its place.

ownership.label: Ownership
ownership.desc: The custom software is yours under the project agreement — not rented from a builder you don't control.

flexibility.label: Flexibility
flexibility.desc: It does exactly what your business needs, not just what a drag-and-drop builder happens to support.

scalability.label: Scalability
scalability.desc: It grows with your volume and complexity instead of hitting a platform ceiling.

noUnnecessaryLock.label: No unnecessary lock-in
noUnnecessaryLock.desc: Standard, portable technology wherever practical — so your core process isn't hostage to one builder's pricing.

whyCustomCallout.title: Why custom, not off-the-shelf
whyCustomCallout.first: I'm code-first: the processes your business runs on get built as software, rather than assembled inside a proprietary visual workflow builder. That buys you flexibility, clearer ownership, and room to grow.
whyCustomCallout.second: Off-the-shelf tools and low-code platforms have their place, and I'll tell you honestly when one is the right fit — including when it means a smaller project for me. But as a process becomes central to how you make money, owning it tends to pay off more than renting it from a builder that can change its pricing or shut down.
whyCustomCallout.third: I use third-party services myself — cloud hosting, databases, AI providers. The point isn't to avoid them, it's to avoid unnecessary lock-in and keep what I build portable.

cta.title: Not sure where to start? That's what the call is for.
cta.subtitle: Book a free consultation and I'll look at the repetitive work costing your team the most — then map out what's worth building first. No pressure, no jargon.

page.title: Software that handles the busywork your team shouldn't be doing.
page.subtitle: Everything below is an example of what I build, not a fixed menu. Every project is designed around your business — your tools, your process, and the specific work you want to stop doing by hand.

delivery.heading: How your software is delivered
delivery.intro: Every project is different, and so is the right operating model. I can run the system for you, deploy it into infrastructure you control, or manage software running inside your own environment — whichever fits how your business works.
